query: INSERT INTO mcp_connector_machine_credentials (user_id, provider, kind, config, secret_ciphertext, secret_nonce, created_by) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7) ON CONFLICT (user_id, provider) DO UPDATE SET kind = EXCLUDED.kind, config = EXCLUDED.config, secret_ciphertext = EXCLUDED.secret_ciphertext, secret_nonce = EXCLUDED.secret_nonce, rotated_at = NOW()
